scope: Actual signed absolute-face hard Gaussian coarea derivative with local residual slack

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.continuousAt_weighted_gaussianFiniteThreshold_of_slack
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {m r : ℕ} (s : Finset (Fin m)) (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector r) (b : RectangleCLT.Vector m),
  (∀ j ∈ s, u j ≠ 0 ∨ b j ≠ 0) →
    ∀ (f : RectangleCLT.Vector r → ℝ),
      Measurable f →
        MeasureTheory.Integrable f (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) →
          ContinuousAt
            (fun c =>
              ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianFiniteThresholdEvent s u c).indicator f
                  g ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r)
            b

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.continuousAt_thresholdSignedSection_of_slack
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {m r : ℕ} (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector r) (b : RectangleCLT.Vector m) (j : Fin m),
  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u j) = 1 →
    ∀ (c₀ : ℝ),
      (∀ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase j,
          RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianNormalProjection (u j) (u l) ≠ 0 ∨
            b l - c₀ * RectangleCLT.faceDot (u l) (u j) ≠ 0) →
        ContinuousAt (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.Printed.thresholdSignedSection u b j) c₀

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.measurable_thresholdSignedSection_parameter
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {m r : ℕ} (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector r) (b : RectangleCLT.Vector m) (j : Fin m),
  Measurable (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.Printed.thresholdSignedSection u b j)

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.integrable_gaussianAbsoluteFaceScore
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {r : ℕ} (u : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
  MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun g => (RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq g - ↑r) * |RectangleCLT.faceDot u g|)
    (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r)

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.gaussianThresholdAbsoluteFaceTrace
endpoints.expanded_type: {m r : ℕ} → (Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector r) → RectangleCLT.Vector m → Fin m → ℝ

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.gaussianThresholdAbsoluteFaceTrace_update_eq_section_integral
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1)) (b : RectangleCLT.Vector m) (j : Fin m),
  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u j) = 1 →
    ∀ (c : ℝ),
      RectangleCLTArxivV1.gaussianThresholdAbsoluteFaceTrace u (Function.update b j c) j =
        ∫ (t : ℝ) in Set.Iic c,
          ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 t *
            (|t| * RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.Printed.thresholdSignedSection u b j t)

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.integrable_abs_mul_thresholdSignedSection
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {m r : ℕ} (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector r) (b : RectangleCLT.Vector m) (j : Fin m),
  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u j) = 1 →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun t => |t| * RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.Printed.thresholdSignedSection u b j t)
      (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1)

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.hasDerivAt_gaussianThresholdAbsoluteFaceTrace_update_of_slack
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1)) (b : RectangleCLT.Vector m) (j : Fin m),
  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u j) = 1 →
    ∀ (c : ℝ),
      (∀ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase j,
          RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gaussianNormalProjection (u j) (u l) ≠ 0 ∨
            b l - c * RectangleCLT.faceDot (u l) (u j) ≠ 0) →
        HasDerivAt (fun t => RectangleCLTArxivV1.gaussianThresholdAbsoluteFaceTrace u (Function.update b j t) j)
          (|c| *
            (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 c *
              RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.Printed.thresholdSignedSection u b j c))
          c

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.ae_hasDerivAt_gaussianThresholdAbsoluteFaceTrace_update
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1)),
  (∀ (j : Fin m), RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u j) = 1) →
    ∀ᵐ (b : RectangleCLT.Vector m),
      ∀ (j : Fin m),
        HasDerivAt (fun t => RectangleCLTArxivV1.gaussianThresholdAbsoluteFaceTrace u (Function.update b j t) j)
          (|b j| *
            (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (b j) *
              RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.Printed.thresholdSignedSection u b j (b j)))
          (b j)
